newsitem.title: CANADA: Nav Canada sets C$750 million in new bonds.
newsitem.headline: Nav Canada sets C$750 million in new bonds.

text.p: Nav Canada set C$750 million in new bonds on Thursday, splitting the issue into three equally-sized tranches with maturities of six, 10, and 30 year, said lead underwriter RBC Dominion Securities Inc.
Nav Canada is a non-profit entity that runs Canada's air traffic control system.
The 5.75 percent six-year bond due April 1, 2002 was priced to yield 5.775 percent, a spread of 16 basis points over comparable Government of Canada bonds.
The 6.6 percent bond due December 1, 2006 was priced to yield 6.613 percent, 25 basis points over the Government of Canada yield curve.
The 7.4 percent bond due June 1, 2027 was priced to yield 7.409 percent, 38 basis points over the Government of Canada yield curve.
The issue will be dated and delivered on December 16.
